Outcome PR B, not a separate PR per bead. Baseline a0c8796e21412a4e4334d4bd5ee928d339638c78 includes 941c8536 coverage and conversation-less reuse/missing-root fixes. Revalidate any newer tip. Approved isolated branch feature/issue-768-history-b-execution stacks on feature/issue-768-history-a-integration. No former test-handoff wait remains. Preserve concurrent work; base fixes land in PR A and propagate into B.
Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, applicable Agent harness/Engine guides and docs/services/message-lifecycle.md. Regressions FIRST; real internal routing, permissions, persistence and Jido, mocking external provider/LLM edges only. Follow issue-level validation and final review/coverage gates. B human UX approval (.32) precedes new browser E2E. Planning only; no implementation, completion or commit/push authorization.

## Work package
private outcomes and explicit busy/steering disposition

**Owners:** Engine admission/finalization and `ExecutionRecord`, Agent API/runtime
control, StreamEvents. Consume B1 identity and B2 authorized bindings.

Tests first: finalization replay/concurrency; invalid capability and actor; one
public-answer owner; same-Person steering; cross-Person control denial; queued input
followed by failure/sealing/overflow; stale handle; failed persistence; LLM/tool
failure; delivery failure after successful execution.

Preserve conversation-less user/assistant rejection with the existing message
unchanged, zero new placements and unchanged transcript position. Preserve the
new Agent API tests proving persistence failure blocks delivery and error logs
exclude sensitive changeset/exception/map details.

Implementation:

- Wire new Person-bound execution ownership, capability hash, private trace/tool
  results, usage and outcomes through `ExecutionRecord`. Preserve legacy references
  and artifact access; do not repair old data or duplicate private data in new
  shareable projections. Finalization is atomic/idempotent against the same UUIDs.
- Retain the conversation-backed execution pair while wiring ExecutionRecord in
  this leg. Its introduction must not relax the new nil-conversation source-conflict
  checks; canonical-only execution without that binding would require a separately
  designed replacement proof, not deletion of a rejection guard.
- Keep ownership transfers inside PersonMerger's transaction through the current
  Conversations read/change/update APIs. Preserve resource IDs, placements,
  capability/message references and rollback; do not restore the removed merge
  helpers or add direct schema persistence to Accounts.
- Account for the existing worker when moving usage into execution-private storage:
  it currently sums assistant Message fields. Define the canonical accounting
  source before cutover and adapt that same worker if needed, preserving legacy
  totals and counting each finalized answer once. Test mixed legacy/new records,
  replay, failed/steered inputs, concurrent models, delayed message dates and an
  input arriving while accounting executes. Private-storage separation must not
  silently zero totals, double-count usage, or introduce a second accounting job.
- Inspect/steer/inject must validate trusted actor and exact active request scope,
  not possession of a registry key. Carry the actual Jido handle to Factory.
- Same-Person explicit inputs may steer that execution; another Person's input
  retains its own ownership. Background messages do not become steering authority.
- Distinguish queued, consumed and terminal-unconsumed input. Use Jido's existing
  `input_injected` event/canonical references to confirm consumption; its queued
  acknowledgement alone does not establish that a request was answered.
- Keep one root execution/public-answer owner and private per-input disposition.
  Use the minimal representation selected in B0 against the existing schema:
  `completed` currently requires a unique public answer, so do not mark a
  second steered execution completed against that same answer. Record the concrete
  receipt/schema decision in its issue; any required DDL is a forward migration
  with fresh/populated-path tests. Do not add a durable queue/crash-recovery system.
- Busy/finalizing inputs receive an explicit result. Unconsumed inputs remain
  factual history with unsuccessful/unconsumed disposition, never a false answer.
- Preserve execution-persisted versus delivery-confirmed results using the new
  Engine delivery boundary. Association recovery never repeats the provider send.
- Carry the locked response row through confirmation preparation and retain the
  exact selected connector for status/delivery; no answer reload or provider-only
  re-resolution after selection. Distinguish these bounded reuse contracts from
  any new execution-record reads, which need their own explicit budget.

Action reuse: extend existing finalize/control operations; no parallel execution
Action or response builder. Mocking: only external HTTP edges; race tests use real
processes and DB locking/events, with no production-only test switches or sleeps.
Documentation: Agent/Engine lifecycle, result shapes and any migration contract.

## Shared preservation contracts

The original remediation proposal was superseded during implementation. Consume
the final contracts, not its intermediate HistoryEvidence/HistoryProvider design.

| Area | Current contract and consequence for B |
| --- | --- |
| Normalized ingress | `Incoming.RoutingContext.conversation_type` is `:one_to_one`, `:room`, `:recipient_addressed`, or nil. Channels owns provider parsing, exact source scope, timestamps and message-local audience. Do not restore `history_kind` or `title_style` transport fields. |
| Policy/capture | `Engine.History.CommunicationPolicy.kind/1` maps neutral facts to Direct/Shared/Replicated; Engine derives titles and capture policy. Reuse normal ingress and `IncomingMessageRouter`; do not restore caller-controlled `capture_history` flags or provider branches in Agent/Engine. |
| Source identity | `SourceIdentity.valid_scope?/1` accepts nil or an opaque 1–255-byte binary. Preserve JSON account-key encoding and canonical identity. Apply `20261003000000_widen_message_source_account_key.exs`; it widens storage to text without rewriting data, and refuses unsafe rollback narrowing. |
| Replay/merge | Conflicting placement/audience fails rather than adopting old replicas. Preserve canonical UUIDs, positions, separate replica resources and post-merge replay behavior. Redelivery never recreates revoked grants. |
| Conversation-less canonical rows | They remain valid canonical content, but `existing_message_id` reuse as an admitted input or confirmed execution response requires the existing conversation-backed proof. A nil conversation returns `:source_conflict` with no row/placement/cursor mutation; do not treat arbitrary canonical IDs as execution capabilities. |
| Delivery | Channels `DeliveryConfirmation.record/3` dispatches neutral receipt/outgoing evidence via Engine `:record_delivery_confirmation`. `Engine.History.Delivery` interprets it and delegates canonical confirmation to `HistoryIngress`. A successful send with unavailable association stays a successful send; no resend through history recovery. |
| Configuration | The schema is `Zaq.Engine.ChannelConfig`, retaining its existing table and IDs. Email persistence/archive policy are Engine-owned; transport receives supplied runtime maps. B fixtures and aliases must follow the moved schema. |
| Provider queries/BO | Room capability/member/message queries are consumer-neutral. Preserve batched BO projections, detail-only provider root fallback, confidential administration and runtime-only archive retry. |
| Missing thread roots | A child transcript and its authorized replies remain usable when no local root exists. Root projection is nullable; mixed pages preserve order, titles and existing root ratings, and rating lookup filters nil/duplicate IDs. BO detail may use its existing authorized provider fallback; Agent hydration must not borrow that admin privilege or invent a root. |
| Ownership APIs | `Conversations.list_owned_transcripts/2`, `list_person_executions/2`, `change_transcript_owner/2`, `update_transcript_owner/2`, `change_execution_owner/2`, `update_execution_owner/2` replace merge-specific context helpers. Reads use literal owners and stable ID order. `lock: true` requires an existing transaction; `allow_missing_table: true` is historical-migration compatibility only, never a live-history error fallback. These are internal storage APIs, not authorization grants. |
| Capture/admission performance | Reuse the connector and canonical message within one capture's recipient fan-out; still validate each target and lock association writes. Admission reuses its validated source result under the existing source lock. Do not hoist these values into cross-request caches or bypass fresh permission checks. |
| Confirmation input | `TranscriptHistory.prepare_execution_response/3` now receives the already-locked response `%Message{}` as its second argument, not an answer ID to reload. Only the enclosing HistoryIngress confirmation transaction supplies that row; preserve pair/source checks and durable recovery. |
| Transport selection | Provider-only delivery/upsert resolves the connector once and calls `fetch_connection_details_for_config/1` on that exact row. Preserve explicit-connector and ambiguity behavior when changing request/status/delivery paths. |
| Accounting | Pending usage jobs coalesce by conversation/model/date only in available/scheduled/retryable states. Executing jobs must allow a later pass. Aggregation locks conversation metadata and sums the explicit message day using a half-open UTC interval; retries replace totals rather than incrementing twice. |
| Tool budgets | SearchKnowledgeBase declares 120,000 ms; effective Jido worker budget is the maximum declared by enabled tools with the ordinary 15,000-ms floor. Preserve live add/remove behavior and the distinction between tool execution, stream inactivity, request wait and delivery deadlines. |

Admission/finalization remain the existing Engine operations. Preserve the current
binding's `conversation_id`, `user_message_id` and opaque `finalization_token` while
adding validated execution references as necessary; update every consumer of any
intentional extension. A message ID or caller-supplied binding is not authority.



## Workspace direction — latest user instruction
User authorized proceeding on a new branch inside the CURRENT worktree, superseding the earlier isolated-worktree requirement. Branch feature/issue-768-history-b-execution created at a0c8796e21412a4e4334d4bd5ee928d339638c78 in agile-pangolin. Do not create/move to another worktree. Check effective branch-specific DB/build settings and concurrent edits before validation. PR B remains stacked on feature/issue-768-history-a-integration; no commit/push/merge implied.

comments.text: B0 technical contract decision for B3 tests/implementation: extend existing ExecutionRecord rather than add an execution queue or independent receipt store. Root execution keeps pending/completed/failed and uniquely owns public_answer_message_id. A steered input gets a private child ExecutionRecord linked by root_execution_id, same literal Person, canonical user_message_id and fresh hash; child statuses queued/consumed/unconsumed cannot hold a public answer. Consumption means correlated Jido input_injected, NOT successful answer; terminal root outcome is recorded separately and queued children become unconsumed. Enforce immutable owner/root/input linkage, same-Person/root-active admission, per-root/input replay uniqueness, distinct root/input and answer checks, exact runtime incarnation control. Forward DDL only; preserve existing rows and test fresh/populated upgrade/guarded rollback. This is a bounded per-input state contract, no durable replay/execution queue. Tests precede production changes. Accounting decision: completed root ExecutionRecord usage counters are authoritative for new executions, selected once by its unique public-answer reference and answer UTC day; steered child rows never add usage. Existing assistant Message counters provide compatibility fallback only where linked completed execution has no usable counters (including legacy records). One existing TokenUsageAggregator performs the joined projection, replacing totals under existing conversation lock and coalesced job/date contract; no second worker, no summing both sources. Private per-tool/trace usage remains solely in ExecutionRecord. Before cutover verify actual usage key normalization and tests for legacy/mixed, zero usage, retry, concurrent models, executing-job follow-up and delayed message date.

Root persistence substep: regressions first demonstrated missing admission record, foreign-actor finalization acceptance and accounting double-counting; extended existing Conversations admission/finalization and existing TokenUsageAggregator rather than creating parallel jobs/response builders. ExecutionLifecycle is local-only transaction-owned private storage: it does not create messages, placements or delivery. New canonical Person records persist capability hashes and private trace/tool/usage/outcome with one public answer; legacy admissions/artifact references remain intact. Engine finalization forwards trusted actor; replay rechecks literal active owner. Latest real-provider/Jido/tool/delivery/replay acceptance passes; expanded 399 tests + 9 properties passed. Child receipt statuses/root linkage and inspect/steer/inject actor controls still outstanding; B3 not complete.

Committed validated root persistence/accounting b2089c95 and receipt schema fae9bb5d. Receipt regression failed before schema changes; 27 tests + 2 properties passed; dedicated empty/populated-root migration down/up preserves complete root structs, and populated-child rollback refuses audit loss (8 tests + 1 property). mix q and commit hooks green. No data repair/backfill or child public-answer sharing. Next: trusted request control authorization and real Jido input_injected consumption/terminal-unconsumed wiring; keep B3 in_progress.

Control authorization committed 6fd8a868: missing/foreign principal request keys no longer expose private registry state or authorize Factory calls; supplied scope mismatch denies; Person controls revalidate active literal identity and current canonical grants through confidential Engine dispatch. Immutable registry input UUID replaces raw-token retention. Regression-first denial test and real Engine grant-revocation/inspection test pass; 164 tests + 5 properties including full authorized_execution acceptance passed. mix q and commit hooks pass (corrected final formatter-only layout after index hook). Next durable receipt state transitions plus Jido consumption and busy routing; B3 remains open.

Consumption substep committed ad2b2475. Regression-first durable queued/consumed/terminal-unconsumed transitions fence finalization with stable ordered input locks; canonical controls require a separate admitted binding and exact content, current literal Person and same authorized transcript. StreamEvents consumes the real input_injected event. Strengthened real-provider/Jido/tool acceptance uses an external LLM barrier, queues canonical steering through Agent API, inspects unchanged request prefix + exact tool call/output + correction, and asserts consumed private child with one root public answer and replay. This exposed Jido control accepting extra_refs rather than refs; corrected actual contract, no synthetic consumed acknowledgement. Strict external continuation fixture preserves protocol/content assertions; shared ToolCallingLLMStub defaults unchanged. Latest 546 tests + 14 properties, mix q, diff check and commit hooks pass. Remaining B3 automatic same-Person busy routing, explicit rejection/finalizing dispositions and race/failure/accounting completion remain open; do not close B3 on this substep.

Shared control extraction committed 3340f3e8 after 96 tests + 1 property and mix q/hooks/diff checks passed. RequestControl owns the same existing authorization/PID/queue/Jido control flow formerly private in Agent.Api; obsolete API copies removed. Local-only lifecycle boundary, not a new Action/tool: prepares automatic busy-input consumer reuse without an Executor -> Agent.Api cycle or duplicated policy. Next regression: provider-ingressed own-Person input while a canonical root is blocked must queue/consume under that root with no second reply; keep unscoped legacy busy behavior intact.

Automatic busy steering committed 74838787 after 597 tests + 15 properties + 6 doctests, mix q, diff check and commit hooks passed. Provider-mention regression first failed to queue; real Jido busy refusal arrives through stream as well as ask admission, both handled by the shared control path. Correct mention fixture includes @zaq rather than relying on raw event mentions alone. Stronger acceptance also exposed unwanted second status posts: Agent admission now checks guard and queues verified same-Person input before new status side effects; queued result stops return hop without public finalization. Exact configured-agent/PID filters and frozen agent identity prevent same-scope cross-runtime steering; legacy busy rejection remains green. Explicit-control and actual provider-mention variants preserve exact actual LLM prefix/tool/result/correction and one public answer. Next B3 terminal/rejection private dispositions and remaining accounting/race checks before completion; no claim that all PR B is done.

Terminal-input race regression fixed and committed 229189f1: previously queue refusal rolled back or never wrote a late input disposition, leaving pending private state. Existing Engine queue/lifecycle now commit authenticated same-transcript late inputs as child unconsumed with terminal_request reason before returning rejection; replay preserves bytes and foreign actor/forged capability cannot mutate them. Reuse existing transaction/lifecycle, local-only not a new Action/tool. 106 tests + 2 properties, mix q/diff and commit hooks pass. B3 remains in_progress for control rejection evidence and remaining race/accounting coverage.

Runtime-rejection disposition substep committed 9655b1ac. Tests first failed on missing confidential reject dispatch. Existing receipt lifecycle now seals queued inputs rejected by actual Jido and preserves consumed/unconsumed evidence on replay; bounded reason categories exclude arbitrary private diagnostics. RequestControl records Engine evidence before returning runtime rejection and catches PID exits after queueing. Real-Jido provider/explicit acceptance deliberately uses a stale request handle to prove actual refusal + durable unconsumed record, then validates normal correction consumption and single root answer; no internal service mocks. 107 tests + 3 properties including monotonicity/idempotency property passed; mix q/diff/hooks green. B3 still open pending remaining accounting, sealing/replay/ownership/race review; no push/merge.

Committed failure/accounting coverage b0e80a80. Root failure preserves private tool diagnostics, seals only queued children as unconsumed and retains consumed evidence with no public answer. New accounting property covers per-counter private override/legacy fallback (including zero/missing counters), every receipt status ignored and retry-idempotent totals; unique generated capabilities preserve schema invariants across property iterations. Expanded affected suite 601 tests + 17 properties + 6 doctests passed; mix q/diff and commit hooks green. Remaining B3 acceptance audit: receipt identity immutability/replay, failed receipt persistence and sealing/overflow races before closing; B4 and follow-on refresh/sync/removal/delivery gates stay open.

Receipt identity/terminal-state audit committed 030f4f15. Regressions first showed ordinary loaded changesets could rebind Person/input/capability/root or reopen consumed receipts. Loaded execution identities/root/public answer now immutable and terminal statuses monotone. Explicit existing Conversations owner-change boundary remains available only for People merge and changes solely owner, preserving accepted merge behavior. Bounded caller search found PersonMerger uses that boundary; Serena returned no Elixir symbols, used bounded native source reads/search. 379 tests + 11 properties including real Jido acceptance and PersonMerger passed, mix q/diff/hooks green. Remaining B3 audit failed persistence/sealing/overflow and root finalization/replay races before closing; no push/merge.
